description: Generate one image through the MiniMax Mavis gateway, either from text only or from text plus reference images. Generation is non-idempotent and consumes quota, so a disconnected call is an uncertain failure that must not be resent blindly.

prompt.description: Image description. When references are given, state which parts of them to keep and which to change.

items.description: A public HTTP(S) image URL or a kkstudio:/resources/<blobId> image resource of the current session.
